content: Uplerlawna mutnu riy riwnu rahu ida terampwogata wehrani wogata

Nhorwua noma a'umkek nana Uplerlawna hopopanni re wogata rhapet reria nohkeran di uhunu re wogata, ne rtorn apitga anni re matni wogata, totpena yana anni rten liola lora me ra'a (keranni) pa yana ora-au rwo'la-rwaini.

Dewade a'umkek nana Uplerlawna hopopanni id owa'ana nmai die nwatiawu tipru, nmai die nodia Uplerlawna mak kden pa nodi liarni, hiwliaini (kniau) maka rtapla la reranni-kiorni. Uplerlawna hopopanni de nhaun wah'a noha pa nakot la hopopan mandadata re mak kodi plolli pa rweyata-rwaniaga la lora me ra'a.

Hopopan de niwra: “Yana mpieyata plein la lora me ra'a (keranni) nor wutga ora-au re honona. Mpiei piena amtapla kniau la mak ktulla-kar lia Uplerlawna tulanni-kniarni re reranni-kiorni totpena yana rler wutga la wnieyata-wnianiawu!”

Noma a'utlin nan lirni niwra: “Hota maka rtapla la reran kiorni, de riy riwnu rahu ida terampwogata wehrani wogata. La' hare honona re, de ra' nan harella la Israel (Yakopa) duratni-waitni riy termida wehrani woru re.

content.text: La durti-waiti ida, de e ra' nana riy riwnu termida wehrani woru, hota la'a Yehuda, Ruben, Gad,

content: La hadewa de a'umkek nan owa'ana rimormiori emekneka en liu'wu-tan miakmu, la'pa riy id mana edon nat niohora riy wo'ira rimormiori mutlialawna re. Hare e rwatiawua nohkeran di hairni-hairni honona, la'pa noh pa'etu-rai piatatra nora leta-leta ror wut nieka wniareini-wniahaurnu. Rimormiori re honona de ema rnanin nana la naniairi raini plalahwa wawahra. Ne honona re rtorreria koram tawi pa rtutrier lia liwangen tiutulu nor wutga Dum A'na de gaini ralamni pa rapal wiutu.

content.text: “It mormiori-lewlewanni di, ha nwatiawua Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu it Orgahi-Orha'ani mak kamtatan la liwangen tiutul die hananni me la' walia Dum A'na de.”

content: Uplerlawna hopopanni-lili'irnu honona rtutrier wutwut pua rpepan reria liwangen tiutul die ne o'ta-mata me hamormiori re wogata wali. Noma hare honona e rwaltiora-rwaltieman la liwangen tiutul die gaini pa ra'uli-rawedia Uplerlawna.

content.text: “Amin (Plola)! Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu mak ama'uli-mawedi mhu'ru-mhelma muh' idma-mrama lia'ara, Omdien la liwangenmu-mtatangenmu, Mutulu-mupetna Mupriri-mukded la'a genmu-tienmu. O' nanpena plollolli me kirkirmu-ralma-riormu ed mak ama'uli-mawedi la'a genmu-tienmu makden la tutullu-lolo'oni. O' ed mak ktorna plolli-mneheni pa nodi liarni. O' ed mak ama'uli-mawedi mhu'ru-mhelma pa nodi liarni. Amin.”

content: La'a o'ta-mata re honona, de ida nmai pia natian a'u niwra: “Riy mak knairia naniairia plalahwa wawahra ri ir he'a, me ha rwatiawu hanmeni?”

Noma awuahla la lirni: “A'uplinga tuna. Tuna nmeh'a nanpena natga hare.” Noma nakot mai a'u niwra: “Hari er mak kler la kropna-krieutu matmiat liawan de. Ral oleka Dum A'na rarni pa ra rpah'ia hare naniayarni pa nwal lia wowo'a-wawahrani.

content.text: Irtutrier lia Uplerlawna liwangen tiutul die gaini. Ne rhima-rre'a me rkola tieru-rawur nehla la E'a la' lelera-melmela la Uplerlawna romni nayanni.
Ne ed Mak kamtatan la liwangen tiutul die, hota Nden wut lia ira totpena Ntera-ndema.
Hota la' yaplara me tier kerna mana ir edonna ra'eram nana.
Ler pahna lawna mana hota edonna nhit nana re.
Yoma Dum A'na makden la liwangen tiutul die onni, hota ed mak klernohor rer ira.
Hota E' ed mak kodia ir la ger ormat mak kodia mormiori-laliahu.
Ne Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu ed mak knah dioinia lui-nuhru mak kden la ir matni.”
